findings.text: The cutpoint header and parent state >=, including equality. The lower footer says right of the line. No fictional observation lies exactly on a cutoff; do not replace the stated equality rule with a strict greater-than rule.

The source tree retains the old landscape cartoon, while both pinned calibration lessons embed v2. Both old and current themes were freshly viewed whole, without treating old art as the current embed.

Native labels retain the fictional PPV counts, fixed score classes, BH selected ranks, binary ROC area, censored uncertainty and separate calibration examples. Geometry and arithmetic still need independent execution checks.
